newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: The Swedish debt market entirely followed foreign markets as these firmed on Thursday.
"It's been enormously foreign driven", one dealer said adding that trading has been extremely nervous. "Nobody seems to want to take on any positions", he said.
"People want to cash in their profits. That's what you see in the whole of Europe and also in the U.S. But the undertone remains very strong and there are buyers too," one analyst said.
The confidence vote in parliament on Friday over comments made by prime minister Goran Persson in China is not expected to have any market impact.
